Dropped into the wild with no clothes, no supplies, and no idea who they’ll be paired with, first encounters can be painfully awkward. Watch the most funny and awkward meet-ups from Naked and Afraid, where survival starts with an introduction no one is ever ready for.

About Naked and Afraid:
What happens when you put two strangers - sans clothes - in some of the most extreme environments on Earth? Each male-female duo is left with no food, no water, no clothes, and only one survival item each as they attempt to survive on their own.

Meanwhile, Mark and Digger reminisce about the good old days while sharing their Apple Brandy with legendary moonshiners JB, Sherrell and more!
